Deliver me, LORD|strong="H3068", from evil men.  
Preserve me from violent men:

LORD|strong="H3068", keep me|strong="H8478"from|strong="H8478"the|strong="H8478"hands of|strong="H8478"the|strong="H8478"wicked|strong="H8478".  
Preserve me|strong="H8478"from|strong="H8478"the|strong="H8478"violent men who have|strong="H8193"determined to|strong="H2534"trip my|strong="H8478"feet.

The|strong="H8104"proud have|strong="H3068"hidden|strong="H5341"a|strong="H3068"snare for|strong="H3027"me|strong="H8104",  
they|strong="H3068"have|strong="H3068"spread the|strong="H8104"cords of|strong="H3068"a|strong="H3068"net by|strong="H3027"the|strong="H8104"path.  
They|strong="H3068"have|strong="H3068"set traps for|strong="H3027"me|strong="H8104". Selah.

LORD|strong="H3068", the|strong="H3068"Lord|strong="H3068", the|strong="H3068"strength of|strong="H3068"my|strong="H3068"salvation,  
you|strong="H6963"have|strong="H3068"covered my|strong="H3068"head in|strong="H3068"the|strong="H3068"day of|strong="H3068"battle.

LORD|strong="H3068", don’t grant the|strong="H3069"desires of|strong="H3117"the|strong="H3069"wicked.  
Don’t let their|strong="H3117"evil plans succeed, or|strong="H3117"they|strong="H3117"will|strong="H3117"become proud. Selah.

As|strong="H3068"for|strong="H3068"the|strong="H5414"head of|strong="H3068"those who|strong="H3068"surround me|strong="H5414",  
let|strong="H5414"the|strong="H5414"mischief of|strong="H3068"their|strong="H3068"own lips cover them|strong="H5414".

Let burning coals fall on|strong="H7218"them.  
Let them be|strong="H8193"thrown into the|strong="H3680"fire,  
into miry pits, from|strong="H8193"where they never rise.

An|strong="H6965"evil speaker won’t be|strong="H1077"established|strong="H6965"in|strong="H5921"the|strong="H5921"earth.  
Evil will|strong="H5307"hunt the|strong="H5921"violent man|strong="H5307"to|strong="H5921"overthrow|strong="H5307"him|strong="H5921".
